about_short_description.short_description: Filestack, Inc. provides a Software-as-a-Service solution to help software developers manage images, videos.

product.name: File Picker
product.description: A customizable file uploader widget that allows users to select and upload files from multiple sources with support for folder uploads and client-side image transformations.

product.name: Upload API
product.description: An API that enables developers to upload files and videos from any source, including URL ingestion and mobile device integration, with enhanced reliability and security.

product.name: Transformations API
product.description: An API that performs image, video, and document transformations, conversions, and optimizations on files before they reach the application.

product.name: Delivery Service (CDN and Viewer)
product.description: A content delivery service that optimizes and securely delivers responsive audio, video, image, and document files globally, including an embeddable file viewer.

product.name: Content Intelligence APIs
product.description: APIs that analyze and understand uploaded content using AI, including object detection, explicit content detection, image tagging, captioning, emotion analysis, and phishing detection.

product.name: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) SDK
product.description: An SDK that extracts text and data from documents by digitizing scanned images and PDFs automatically.
